questions.displayText:
Have you ever had a condition that affects your heart or blood pressure? Examples include:

  • High or low blood pressure
  • Dizziness or faintness when standing up
  • Heart failure
  • An irregular heartbeat (arrythmias)
  • Fluid or inflammation around the heart
  • Heart valve or structural heart problems
  • A heart attack, angina, stroke or mini-stroke (TIA)
  • Another heart or blood vessel condition
